clue.text: Controversial artwork themes ring a bell, vaguely

indicators.note: done vaguely, without precision, so these words' letters are loosely reassembled

explanation.surface: Some contested piece of art apparently reminds the viewer of familiar motifs, though only faintly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vaguely' rearranges all fifteen letters of THEMES RING A BELL.
explanation.definitionFit: These Parthenon sculptures, held in the British Museum, are the subject of a long dispute with Greece over their return.

clue.text: Somehow gets in — it's as tight as can be

indicators.note: somehow suggests by some unknown means, so the letters are arranged differently

parts.note: the apostrophe is ignored, leaving three letters

explanation.surface: Something squeezes its way in, being as tight a fit as possible.
explanation.definitionFit: Tight is an informal word for mean with money, and the superlative is the meanest of all.

clue.text: Eg. a pledge, extremely large, withdrawn

parts.note: a pledge is a vow

indicators.note: drawn back, so the extreme letters picked out are taken in the opposite order
the extremes of the word large are its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A promise, for instance, of a very large sum, later retracted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extremely' takes L and E from large; 'withdrawn' turns them round to EL.
explanation.definitionFit: The letter a is an example of one of the five vowels of the alphabet.

clue.text: Some passed out after knocking back port

indicators.note: knocking back a drink downs it, here also reading the run backwards
some of the letters of passed out are taken, a run within them

explanation.surface: A few people collapsed after drinking too much port.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knocking back' reads PASSEDOUT backwards, TUODESSAP, and 'Some' takes the run inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Odessa is a major seaport on the Black Sea coast of Ukraine.

clue.text: Ridicule encountered on free course

indicators.note: the second word is met placed on, i.e. after, the first

parts.note: spare means free, unoccupied
to rib is to tease or ridicule

explanation.surface: Someone is mocked while out on a free golf course.
explanation.definitionFit: A meal is made of courses, and a cut of pork ribs can be served as one.

clue.text: Note spies left features procedure

parts.note: fa is a note of the tonic sol-fa scale
the CIA is the US intelligence agency

explanation.surface: A memo records that agents have left a procedure for the main items in place.
explanation.definitionFit: Features here means the face, and a beauty treatment for the face is so named.

clue.text: Glimpse of posh neckwear in annual varsity event

parts.note: a boa is a fancy feathery scarf worn round the neck
a trace is a faint sign or glimpse

explanation.surface: A hint of elegant scarves is seen at a yearly university fixture.
explanation.walkthrough: The Boat Race is the annual Oxford v Cambridge rowing contest on the Thames.
explanation.definitionFit: The Oxford and Cambridge universities hold this rowing contest every spring.

clue.text: Characteristic effects

definitions.meaning: a noun: a quality or attribute of something
personal effects are one's belongings or possessions

explanation.definitionFit: A property is an attribute of a thing, and also what someone owns.

clue.text: Judge is introduced to English backs

indicators.note: backs, as in goes backwards, signals the letters are read in reverse

parts.note: someone introduced to another meets them

explanation.surface: A magistrate is presented to English supporters.
explanation.definitionFit: To esteem something can mean to consider or judge it, as in esteeming it a privilege.

clue.text: Complex or simple lubricant

indicators.note: complex means intricate or tangled, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A grease, whether elaborate or basic.
explanation.definitionFit: Oil from the sperm whale was once widely used to lubricate machinery.

clue.text: Hamper Sue placed in punt

indicators.note: one word is placed inside the other

parts.note: a punt is a bet
to sue for something is to ask for it

explanation.surface: A picnic hamper belonging to Sue is put in a flat-bottomed boat.
explanation.walkthrough: A punt is both a river boat and, in British slang, a gamble.
explanation.definitionFit: A hamper is a large basket, typically holding food for a picnic.

clue.text: Meat product weightlifter needs?

definitions.meaning: a jellied preparation made from a pig's head

explanation.definitionFit: Brawn is both pressed head meat and physical muscle strength.

clue.text: Pressman attached to PM appeared first

indicators.note: the newsman is joined on after the leader

parts.note: PM stands for Prime Minister, also called the premier
an editor, ED, is a newspaperman

explanation.surface: A journalist tied to the Prime Minister was first to appear.
explanation.definitionFit: A film or play premiered when it was shown publicly for the first time.

clue.text: Canine epithet for Jason?

parts.note: a dog breed's name that could describe Jason, who brought back the Golden Fleece

explanation.definitionFit: This dog breed is named for its colour and its fetching, as Jason fetched the Golden Fleece.

clue.text: Quickly write report of delayed start to match?

definitions.meaning: to dash off a piece of writing without effort

definitions.text: report of delayed start to match?
definitions.meaning: news that the coin-spin before a game has been called off

explanation.definitionFit: To produce writing hastily, and literally, word that the pre-match coin flip is not happening.

clue.text: Top hat thrown up with ecstasy

indicators.note: in a down clue, thrown up means read upwards, i.e. reversed

parts.note: tile is slang for a hat
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: A top hat tossed in the air in delight.
explanation.definitionFit: The elite are the top people in a group, its best members.

clue.text: What parliamentarians do, as member is overdue

parts.note: a leg is a limb, or member
taken as written
overdue means late

explanation.surface: Members of Parliament make law, though one of them is behind schedule.
explanation.definitionFit: Making laws is the core business of those who sit in a parliament.

clue.text: Mounted team catching live goats

indicators.note: the reversed team holds the other word inside
in a down clue, mounted means raised up, so the letters read upwards

parts.note: a cricket or football team is an eleven, XI
to be is to live, exist

explanation.surface: A team on horseback catches some wild goats.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'Mounted' reverses the team's Roman numeral eleven to IX, and 'catching' means it goes round the word for live.
explanation.definitionFit: Ibex are wild mountain goats with long curved horns; the plural is the same as the singular.

clue.text: Reporter's come across a boundary in symbolic form

indicators.note: a reporter speaks the words, so we go by sound

parts.note: met (came across) plus a plus four (a boundary in cricket) when spoken

explanation.surface: A journalist's account of stumbling on a border is written in figurative language.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reporter's' signals sound: MET A FOUR said aloud. In cricket a boundary scores four runs.
explanation.definitionFit: A metaphor is a figure of speech that presents one thing symbolically as another.

clue.text: Typical dog's run past

definitions.note: the 's reads as is, so the definition is a typical dog's name

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for run
over means past, finished

explanation.surface: An ordinary dog's daily run is over.
explanation.definitionFit: Rover is the stock name for a pet dog, as Fido is.

clue.text: Reduce cover, not capital

parts.note: to lower is to reduce
a case is a protective cover

explanation.surface: Cut insurance cover, but not using capital funds.
explanation.definitionFit: Small letters, as opposed to capitals, are the ones once kept in the printer's bottom tray.

clue.text: Deliquescent globules dropping first fluid

indicators.note: fluid means flowing and changeable, so the remaining letters are rearranged
the word globules loses its first letter

explanation.surface: Melting blobs drip, the first of them liquid.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dropping first' removes G, leaving LOBULES; 'fluid' rearranges those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A deliquescent substance absorbs moisture until it dissolves, so it is readily dissolved.

clue.text: Complete justification, as disaster just avoided

parts.note: to close is to complete or conclude
call means reason or justification, as in no call for it

explanation.surface: A full explanation is given for how catastrophe was narrowly missed.
explanation.definitionFit: A narrow escape from danger is an idiom for something that nearly happened.

clue.text: Maestro of opera doubly popular on return

parts.note: Tosca is Puccini's opera

indicators.note: the doubled word is read backwards
the word for popular is given twice

parts.note: in means popular, fashionable

explanation.surface: A conductor of an opera is twice as popular after his comeback.
explanation.walkthrough: 'doubly' makes ININ, which 'on return' reverses to NINI.
explanation.definitionFit: Arturo Toscanini was a celebrated Italian conductor, a master of the orchestra.

clue.text: This could take the gloss off nightclub artiste

definitions.text: This could take the gloss off
definitions.meaning: a solvent that removes paint or varnish
a performer who undresses for an audience

explanation.definitionFit: A paint remover and an exotic dancer who takes off clothes share this name.

clue.text: After appropriate letters

parts.note: post- is a prefix meaning after
to bag is to seize or appropriate

explanation.surface: Seize what is fitting afterwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A postbag is the mail received, the batch of correspondence someone gets.

clue.text: Facts in memory upset fighter going in for the kill

definitions.text: fighter going in for the kill

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset means turned upside down, so read backwards
the facts go inside the memory

parts.note: ROM is read-only memory in computing
data are facts

explanation.surface: Facts in a recollection disturb a fighter moving in for the finish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts the facts inside the memory, giving RODATAM, and 'upset' reverses that in this down clue. ROM is read-only memory.
explanation.definitionFit: The matador is the bullfighter who delivers the fatal sword thrust.

clue.text: Staff see gutless Minister in residence here

parts.note: to man is to staff

indicators.note: without its insides, leaving only its outer letters

explanation.surface: Staff observe a spineless government minister living there.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gutless' leaves S and E from see.
explanation.definitionFit: A manse is the house provided for a Presbyterian minister.

clue.text: Company's mixed drink, primarily of vodka

definitions.note: the 's reads as is, so the definition is a company

parts.note: kir is white wine mixed with cassis

indicators.note: primarily means in the first place, so the initial letters are taken

explanation.surface: A firm's cocktail, made chiefly of vodka.
explanation.definitionFit: The Kirov is the famous ballet and opera company of St Petersburg.

clue.text: Democrat's taken on Socialists, there being no Liberal handy

indicators.note: the socialists come on after the Democrat

parts.note: D abbreviates Democrat

indicators.note: the Liberal is left out of the word for socialists

parts.note: the left are socialists

explanation.surface: A Democrat recruits Socialists, as no Liberal is available.
explanation.walkthrough: 'there being no' removes L from LEFT, leaving EFT.
explanation.definitionFit: Deft and handy both mean skilful and dexterous with one's hands.
